fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner found that rhiza run resume (internal/api/run.go) already continues an interrupted plan run whose record landed, while the daemon's Resumable (internal/daemon/pick.go) resumes only runs on accepted change sets and the inbox (internal/api/inbox.go) lists such a run as skipped with rhiza run abandon, and its gone() hides failed and gave-up plan runs on a landed record. Two questions went to the arbiter: should the daemon resume such a run, and should gone() stop hiding them. The arbiter ruled (decision-plan-landed-resumable, assumed, would have escalated): a plan-workflow run on a landed change set counts as in flight; the daemon gives it its one resume; the inbox stops listing it as skipped, shows gave-up with rhiza run resume after a second interruption, and shows a failed one with rhiza run resume --retry. Only the plan workflow and only landed are exempt. The plan also replaces leafless draft 01M6H5VQ231Z8V (linked relates-to, withdrawn) and serves milestone-25.
fields.title: Plan of 01M6JZD: plan runs on a landed record are resumable (autonomous)
